title: Unintended network exposure of local console
treatment: Mitigate through loopback defaults and exact Host validation
evidence: Inspect bind address and reject disallowed Host in HTTP tests

title: Unrelated website mutates synthetic state
treatment: Mitigate with exact Origin checks and CSRF token on writes
evidence: Allowed write succeeds while missing token and unrelated Origin fail

title: Invalid response transition corrupts incident state
treatment: Mitigate with allowlisted operations and ordered state transitions
evidence: Direct operation tests reject skipped or repeated transitions without state change

title: Malformed or excessive input exhausts local service
treatment: Mitigate through request bounds and bounded retained records
evidence: Oversized body and unsupported scenario rejection tests

title: Untrusted display text becomes executable content
treatment: Mitigate with restrictive CSP and text-safe rendering
evidence: Inspect response headers and render-path handling of server strings

title: Partial persistence or unnoticed audit modification
treatment: Mitigate using atomic updates and verification of keyed audit chain
evidence: Restart retains state and changed entries or wrong key fail verification

title: Host administrator replaces state and audit key
treatment: Accept local trust limit and require independent evidence protection for production
evidence: No immutable or nonrepudiation assurance from host-controlled key and history

title: Fraud or detection output overstates actual coverage
treatment: Mitigate with positive and negative fixtures plus explanations and synthetic labels
evidence: Test expected matches and nonmatches and review reason-bearing fraud outputs

title: Simulated containment mistaken for real account enforcement
treatment: Mitigate through explicit local-only action labels and incident playbooks
evidence: Review UI action results and exported evidence for simulation labels

title: Runtime secrets or databases committed to source
treatment: Mitigate through ignore rules source checks and staged-change review
evidence: Run source checks and inspect tracked paths before release

title: Local storage copied or read by another host user
treatment: Require host access restrictions and production encrypted storage outside this demo
evidence: SQLite is unencrypted and no HSM or hardware-backed key protection is claimed

title: Single-host failure loses the local demonstration
treatment: Document limited local recovery and require independent production resilience
evidence: Preserve matching database and key and validate restored chain; no HA or RTO guarantee

title: Compliance or Swiss residency asserted without evidence
treatment: Mitigate by documenting modeled assumptions and deferring legal applicability claims
evidence: Review reference mapping and deployment assumptions against actual evidence

title: Platform or dependency drift breaks reproducibility
treatment: Mitigate with standard-library runtime and Windows/Linux verification
evidence: Run current test suite on supported Python versions and inspect completed CI results
